name: Artifact Storage
description: Stores and retrieves named artifacts — design specs, research notes, code analysis.

tools.name: knowledge-artifacts.listArtifacts
tools.description: Lists artifacts. Filter by taskId, status (draft/in_review/revised/approved), or repo+branch.

status.description: Filter by status: draft, in_review, revised, or approved

tools.name: knowledge-artifacts.saveArtifact
tools.description: Creates a new artifact (status defaults to draft). Signature: artifacts.saveArtifact({ name, content, type?, metadata? }).

tools.name: knowledge-artifacts.readArtifact
tools.description: Reads an artifact by ID. Signature: artifacts.readArtifact({ artifactId }).

tools.name: knowledge-artifacts.updateArtifactStatus
tools.description: Update artifact lifecycle status (draft → in_review → approved, or revised → draft). Used by ProcessAgent and review workflows.

status.description: New status: draft, in_review, revised, or approved

tools.name: knowledge-artifacts.promoteToKB
tools.description: Promote an approved artifact to the knowledge base. Creates/updates a KB doc with version tracking.
